This vertical-format illustration features a light-grey textured background with thin, dark, jagged cracks. At the top, the large grey capital letters "TEMPO" are centered above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above this, smaller white text reads "SINDIKAT PENGGANGSIR ANGGARAN JATAH DAERAH / ANCAMAN MANGKRAK MEGAPROYEK KALIBARU".

In the center, a flesh-toned human hand extends from the left toward a metallic robotic hand descending from the upper right. The index fingers of both hands almost touch. The robotic hand is white and silver with visible joints, silver rivets, and blue and red wires emerging from its wrist.

Below the hands, large grey text reads "OUTLOOK EKONOMI 2019 REVOLUSI 4.0 ADALAH KUNCI". A paragraph of smaller black text follows: "MENDORONG PENINGKATAN DAYA SAING, PENERAPAN TEKNOLOGI GENERASI KEEMPAT DI INDUSTRI NASIONAL DIPERKIRAKAN MAKIN BERGAIRAH PADA TAHUN DEPAN. TUMPANG-TINDIH REGULASI MASIH MENJADI KENDALA."

The bottom right contains a barcode, numerical sequences, and publication details: "12-18 NOVEMBER 2018", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "ISSN: 0126-4273". A solid red border runs along the bottom and the left side.
